propositions: Add commit_and_push_tickets_branch function to stage and commit dirty tracker changes under an acquired write lock before delegating to push_tickets_branch.

Reject commits when rebase/merge-recovery is in progress using check_no_rebase_in_progress; strict mode raises PushDeliveryError with merge-recovery-blocked reason, default mode warns and returns without push.
Apply supplied git user identity via git -c user.name and user.email flags; use ambient identity when omitted and never mutate global or repository config.

Handle lock, stage, and commit failures distinctly: strict mode raises PushDeliveryError with specific reasons (commit-lock-timeout, stage-failed, commit-failed); default mode warns and returns while retaining dirty content for later retry.

Delegate unconditionally to push_tickets_branch after optional commit, even when tree is clean but locally ahead; under strict mode, persistent rejection raises PushDeliveryError rather than reporting success.
Extend the private CLI adapter at python -m rebar._store.push with commit-and-push subcommand while preserving the existing push action unchanged.
